description: Vital Signs: Traffic Volumes At Regional Gateways – by Gateway is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. VITAL SIGNS INDICATOR Traffic Volumes at Regional Gateways (T6) FULL MEASURE NAME Daily vehicles along entry/exit points to the Bay Area LAST UPDATED April 2020 DESCRIPTION Traffic volumes at regional gateways refers to the number of vehicles crossing county boundaries on a typical day to enter or exit the nine-county San Francisco Bay Area. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The portal files it under the category Roadways. The table has 8 columns. Attribution on the portal: California Department of Transportation: Annual Traffic Volume Reports. The portal shows 2020-04-13 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
